बॉस! रणबीर कपूर का जलवा बॉक्स ऑफिस पर थमने का नाम ही नहीं ले रहा है! 🔥

Animal के धमाकेदार प्रदर्शन के बाद अब उनकी फिल्म Ramayana ने भी बॉक्स ऑफिस पर अपना कमाल दिखाना शुरू कर दिया है। 💥
प्री-दिवाली समय होने के बावजूद इस फिल्म ने शुरुआती दो दिनों के अंदर ही भारत में 100 crore net collections का आंकड़ा पार कर लिया है। 🚀
इस शानदार कमाई के साथ रणबीर कपूर को Koimoi Star Ranking में पूरे 100 points का बड़ा फायदा मिला है।
अब रणबीर कपूर के कुल 1550 points हो चुके हैं, जिसके साथ उन्होंने Aamir Khan के 1500 points को पछाड़कर 6th spot पर कब्जा जमा लिया है! 👏

क्या आपको लगता है कि Ramayana आने वाले दिनों में बॉक्स ऑफिस के नए रिकॉर्ड बनाएगी? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Box Office: Ranbir Kapoor Overtakes Aamir Khan In Koimoi Star Ranking As Ramayana Enters 100 Crore Net Club!
ctx.summary:
Ramayana crossed 100 crore net at the Indian box office in 2 days, crediting 100 points to Ranbir Kapoor in Koimoi Star Ranking. 
 The post  Box Office: Ranbir Kapoor Overtakes Aamir Khan In Koimoi Star Ranking As Ramayana Enters 100 Crore Net Club!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
After Animal , everyone was excited to see how Ranbir Kapoor’s next film performs at the Indian box office, and so far, things have been good. Although Ramayana opened below expectations, it has performed well so far, given the pre-Diwali period. In the first two days, it has entered the 100 crore club in net collections. With this achievement, the film has helped Ranbir make gains in Koimoi Star Ranking. Keep reading for a detailed report!
For the unversed, in Koimoi’s Star Power Index, aka Star Ranking, actors are allotted points based on their films (Bollywood/Hindi) in the coveted box-office clubs (based on Indian collections only), such as the 100 crore club, 200 crore club, and more. For example, 100 points are awarded for a film in the 100-crore club, and so on. 50 points each are given for a film in the top 10 overseas grossers of Bollywood.
With Animal, Ranbir Kapoor saw a big surge in his points tally, and now, with Ramayana , the momentum continues for him. The magnum opus made a smashing entry into the 100 crore club in India, resulting in a 100-point increase for the superstar. With this, his total has now reached 1550 points in Koimoi Star Ranking.
With a total of 1550 points , Ranbir Kapoor has surpassed Aamir Khan ( 1500 points ) to secure the 6th spot in Star Ranking. With Ramayana expected to score big over the course of its run, Ranbir is expected to make big gains in the points table.
